findings.description: Hardcoded API key found in source code: 'sk-7928cff15f944ca185c92f7da21c591c'. This exposes credentials to anyone with access to the codebase, allowing unauthorized use of the API. Move the key to an environment variable or secrets manager.

The user_id parameter is directly interpolated into the URL without URL encoding. If user_id is attacker-controlled, it may enable path traversal or manipulation of the request endpoint (e.g., using '../' or extra query parameters). Use request params or URL-encode the value.

fix_description: 1) Remove the hardcoded API key and load it from an environment variable or secrets manager, e.g., `import os; API_KEY = os.environ["API_KEY"]`. 2) URL-encode the user_id or pass it as a params value to avoid path traversal/endpoint manipulation, e.g., `requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/users/{requests.utils.quote(user_id)}", ...)` or use `params={"user_id": user_id}` if the API supports query parameter style.
